grid.layout: two by two behind the start/finish line on the loadout apron

out_of_bounds.lateral_rule: hull centre beyond (station width_m / 2 + 6.0) m along the station normal
out_of_bounds.vertical_rule: hull centre more than 2.5 m below the local station elevation
out_of_bounds.note: The pan surface off the causeway looks drivable and deliberately is not. The collision shell ends at the kerb line.

recovery.rejoin_rule: Nearest station BEHIND the exit point by arc length, on the centreline, at local elevation plus 0.95 m, facing the station heading.

high_risk_sequence.name: BRINE CUT
high_risk_sequence.reason: Kerb height is 0.05 m, so the transition off the causeway carries almost no vertical cue. This is the intended risk. The recovery volume is widened rather than the kerb raised.
